name: psd-ecommerce
description: PSD's ecommerce reporting agents (DTC growth suite). Fire any /ecom-* agent to pull Polar Analytics data, produce a skimmable report in the house style as HTML + PDF, save copies to the project reports folder, and (if you opt in) log action items to Asana. Includes review, ads, retention, merch, pricing, cro, finance, returns, forecast, sale-recap, and web-daily-flash (a daily T-1 web snapshot), plus four ad-hoc diagnostic audits (page-friction, cart-checkout, PDP merchandising, and site-speed).
